FAQ

Good Questions

How long do the puddings stay fresh?

Keep them chilled and enjoy within 4 days for the crispiest crumble and freshest fruit.

Do you offer delivery?

Yes — same-day delivery in select areas, or swing by and pick up fresh from the studio.

Are the puddings nut-free?

Most flavors are, except our Pistachio Banana. Check each label for full allergen info.

Can I order in bulk for events?

Absolutely — we cater parties, offices, and every burp-worthy celebration in between.
